result.reason: Section 2.1 reaches the fallback: any commitment is confined to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days’ notice, and addressed through a true-up rather than an express penalty or take-or-pay charge. The revision is targeted and does not alter unrelated restrictions. However, Section 12.3 remains facially inconsistent because it states that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, while Section 2.1 permits an Order Form commitment. A conforming carve-out or clarification in Section 12.3 would improve coherence. The true-up should also expressly be calculated against the commitment as reduced following notice.
